pmoActions.action: Baseline plan, wave sequencing and RACI approved by management
Obtain commercial sign-off to remove Impressions and Reach from client reports
pmoActions.notes: Gate for M1. Commercial risk if removed unsanctioned.

pmoActions.action: Confirm internal vs client rejection scope and lookback window for the re-add alert
pmoActions.notes: Gate for M1; blocks CAMP-5 build.

pmoActions.action: Decide page size per screen: 100 influencers vs 50 at brand level
pmoActions.notes: Gate for M1. Documented conflict in the source document.

pmoActions.action: Establish whether TikTok Spark Code API access and usage rights are available
pmoActions.notes: Needed before W3 report build; descope if no access.

pmoActions.action: Agree the internal-rejection taxonomy: stage, team and reason codes
pmoActions.notes: Needed before W4 starts; blocks APR-2 and APR-3.

pmoActions.action: Scope the full product vision deliverable
Approve the master brand category list and retroactive cleanup plan
pmoActions.notes: Gate for M1. Unblocks BRD-1, REP-17, WSH-2, WSH-6.

pmoActions.action: Fix the exact list of statuses for the Scanner Approved tabs
Decide demo campaign data approach: real campaign vs synthetic data
pmoActions.notes: Privacy implications if real data is used.

pmoActions.action: Confirm ownership and access model for Bee Cloud reconciliation
Set up weekly PMO reporting cadence and owner-level capacity review
Run end-to-end UAT across all nine E2E stages and obtain go-live sign-off

pmoE2EStages.name: Brand Onboarding & Categorisation
pmoE2EStages.description: Brand intake, category assignment and platform enablement — the taxonomy every other stage depends on.
pmoE2EStages.modulesInvolved: Brand Management, Influencer Management, Needs Classification, Platform & Homepage
pmoE2EStages.entryCriteria: New or existing brand recorded; category taxonomy available.
pmoE2EStages.exitCriteria: Brand has a category, Gender Target and verified public content; historical brands backfilled.

pmoE2EStages.name: Influencer Discovery & Sourcing
pmoE2EStages.description: Finding, filtering and qualifying influencers, including Look-Alike and not-yet-worked-with talent.
pmoE2EStages.modulesInvolved: Brand Management, Community Team, Influencer Management
pmoE2EStages.entryCriteria: Brand profile and target audience known.
pmoE2EStages.exitCriteria: Qualified candidate set with Average Views, status and platform coverage validated.

pmoE2EStages.name: List Building (Wishlist)
pmoE2EStages.description: Building and exporting curated lists per brand, including similar-brand suggestions and rejected-row reporting.
pmoE2EStages.entryCriteria: Candidate set shortlisted for the brand.
pmoE2EStages.exitCriteria: List built and exported, with rejected rows reported and excluded records honoured.

pmoE2EStages.name: Approval & Client Sign-off
pmoE2EStages.description: Routing influencers for approval, client decisions, internal rejection tracking, audit log and resets.
pmoE2EStages.modulesInvolved: Approval Request, Campaign Management, Influencer Management
pmoE2EStages.exitCriteria: Every influencer has a final Approved or Rejected state, fully audit-logged.

pmoE2EStages.name: Campaign Setup & Booking
pmoE2EStages.description: Booking orders, campaign creation, briefs and multi-campaign tracking.
pmoE2EStages.modulesInvolved: Brand Management, Campaign Management, Influencer Management
pmoE2EStages.entryCriteria: Approved roster confirmed; budget and brief agreed.
pmoE2EStages.exitCriteria: Booking order raised and campaign live with tracking configured.

pmoE2EStages.name: Field Execution & Coverage
pmoE2EStages.description: Branch visits, scanner-verified attendance, coverage capture and data-integrity repair.
pmoE2EStages.modulesInvolved: Admin & Scanner, Brand Management, Campaign Management, Influencer Management, Technical & Automation
pmoE2EStages.exitCriteria: Visits confirmed via Scanner and all coverage assets captured, verified and complete.

pmoE2EStages.name: Content Capture & Best Media
pmoE2EStages.description: Content taxonomy, top vs recent performance and automatic refresh of media metrics.
pmoE2EStages.modulesInvolved: Brand Management, Influencer Management, Reports & Analytics, Technical & Automation
pmoE2EStages.exitCriteria: Content classified by type and audio; top and recent performance measured on refreshed metrics.

pmoE2EStages.name: Reporting & Client Delivery
pmoE2EStages.description: Single and consolidated client reporting, multi-format export, drill-down and brand breakdowns.
pmoE2EStages.entryCriteria: Campaign period closed and metrics stable.
pmoE2EStages.exitCriteria: Client report delivered in the requested format with drill-down and per-campaign breakdown.

pmoE2EStages.name: Automation, Notifications & Governance
pmoE2EStages.description: Shift summaries, unanswered-message alerts, platform-mismatch guards and programme governance.
pmoE2EStages.modulesInvolved: Admin & Scanner, Notifications & Auto Emails, Platform & Homepage, WhatsApp Communication
pmoE2EStages.entryCriteria: Operational data flowing from all prior stages.
pmoE2EStages.exitCriteria: Alerts, shift summaries and reconciliation running with defined thresholds.

pmoMilestones.name: Programme kick-off & baseline approval
pmoMilestones.gateCriteria: Baseline plan, RACI and wave sequencing signed off by management.

pmoMilestones.name: Scope lock — critical clarifications closed
pmoMilestones.gateCriteria: All P0 clarifications closed: page-size conflict, coverage-metric sign-off, re-add alert scope and the brand category list. Lower-priority clarifications tracked to their own wave gate.

pmoMilestones.name: Data foundation complete
pmoMilestones.gateCriteria: Brand categories applied retroactively, city and multi-country logic live, SWARM supported, report metrics governed.

pmoMilestones.name: Influencer management core released
pmoMilestones.gateCriteria: Chained filtering, campaign filter with statuses, CONTENT section, pagination and Average Views in production.

pmoMilestones.name: Reporting suite v2 live
pmoMilestones.gateCriteria: Consolidated report, per-campaign charts, Excel and PowerPoint export and templates available to clients.

pmoMilestones.name: Lists, approval & community workflow live
pmoMilestones.gateCriteria: Wishlist exports, EXCLUDE scope, approval log, reset, export and community-created influencers all shipped.

pmoMilestones.name: Brand, platform & field operations live
pmoMilestones.gateCriteria: Brand history, Gender Target, scanner tabs and booking-order brand intelligence in production.

pmoMilestones.name: Automation & communication live
pmoMilestones.gateCriteria: Coverage reconciliation, cross-platform messaging guard and shift/alert emails running.

pmoMilestones.name: End-to-end UAT sign-off & go-live
pmoMilestones.gateCriteria: Full E2E regression across all nine stages passed; hypercare window opened.

pmoQuestions.question: Does 'rejected before' mean client rejection only or internal rejection too, and what lookback window applies?
pmoQuestions.impact: Blocks CAMP-05 build; ambiguity in the acceptance criteria.

pmoQuestions.question: Page size: 100 influencers per page (INF-11) vs 50 at brand level (BRD-05) — which applies where?
pmoQuestions.impact: Direct conflict between two requirements; both cannot be met until resolved.

pmoQuestions.question: Are the statuses to be shown campaign statuses (Confirmed / Visit) or message statuses (Sent / Replied / Not yet replied)?
pmoQuestions.impact: UI design blocked; different data sources required.

pmoQuestions.question: What is the internal-rejection taxonomy: stage, team and reason codes?
pmoQuestions.impact: Blocks APR-02 and APR-03; W4 work cannot start.

pmoQuestions.question: Influencer History navigation model: single ACTIVE section vs split by brand?
pmoQuestions.impact: UX design decision; affects navigation complexity.

pmoQuestions.question: What are the unanswered-message alert thresholds per channel?
pmoQuestions.impact: Blocks NOT-03 implementation; thresholds drive alert logic.

pmoRaidItems.description: Brand categories must be applied retroactively across all historical brands before dependent features can work
pmoRaidItems.mitigation: Start BRD-2 in W1 with a dedicated data pass; freeze the category list before cleanup begins.

pmoRaidItems.description: 14 clarifications are open at kick-off; unresolved items silently stall whole waves
pmoRaidItems.mitigation: Close all clarifications by M1 (week 4); escalate any item still open at that gate to management.

pmoRaidItems.description: Coverage files present in Bee Cloud but not in the system mean unbilled work
pmoRaidItems.mitigation: Weekly automated reconciliation with an exception report reviewed by Operations and Finance.

pmoRaidItems.description: Report metric removal (Impressions / Reach) may be commercially sensitive with existing clients
pmoRaidItems.mitigation: Secure written commercial sign-off before the change ships; keep the admin toggle ready as a rollback.

pmoRaidItems.description: Retroactive data cleanup on influencer city and country may overwrite deliberately-set values
pmoRaidItems.mitigation: Log every automatic change with before/after values and provide an admin revert.

pmoRaidItems.description: Large reporting wave concentrates load on a small Data/BI team
pmoRaidItems.mitigation: Balance the waves and consider temporary capacity for W3; monitor effort per owner on the dashboard.

pmoRaidItems.description: Scope creep: the source document is a wish list, not a prioritised backlog
pmoRaidItems.mitigation: Enforce the P0/P1/P2 priorities in this register; any addition requires an equal-value descope.

pmoRaidItems.description: The 17 items marked DONE in the document are functionally complete and need only regression verification
pmoRaidItems.mitigation: Verify each DONE item during W0 and re-open any that fail, re-pointing them into the relevant wave.

pmoRaidItems.description: One full-stack squad of roughly nine roles is available throughout the programme
pmoRaidItems.mitigation: Confirm capacity at M0; the schedule is capacity-driven and will slip if the squad shrinks.

pmoRaidItems.description: All 74 NEW requirements are in scope for this programme release
pmoRaidItems.mitigation: Confirm scope at baseline; if the release must shrink, cut by P2 first.

pmoRaidItems.description: Page-size conflict (50 vs 100) blocks INF-11 and BRD-5 completion criteria
pmoRaidItems.mitigation: Management decision logged as ACT-04; hold pagination sizing until resolved.

pmoRaidItems.description: Reports module header claims 22 requirements but only 21 are listed
pmoRaidItems.mitigation: Reconcile the count with the document author; add the missing requirement if one exists.

pmoRaidItems.description: Reporting and Wishlist intelligence depend on brand categories (BRD-2) landing first
pmoRaidItems.mitigation: BRD-2 scheduled in W1 as a hard predecessor; tracked on the E2E view.

pmoRaidItems.description: Approval workflow work depends on the internal-rejection taxonomy decision
pmoRaidItems.mitigation: Close Q-04 before W4 starts; W4 is scheduled to begin after the clarification gate.

pmoRaidItems.description: Community-created influencers must route through the approval workflow
pmoRaidItems.mitigation: COM-1 sequenced after APR-1; both in W4.

pmoRequirements.title: Approval request status filter
pmoRequirements.titleAr: فلتر لطلب الموافقة بحالاته Pending / Approved / Rejected
pmoRequirements.description: Filter approval requests across all three states (Pending, Approved, Rejected) so it is obvious where work is stuck — 200 influencers waiting a week signals a bottleneck.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Each of the three states filters correctly with accurate counts.

pmoRequirements.title: Client coverage-rejection system (Wrong Coverage)
pmoRequirements.titleAr: نظام واضح لرفض تغطيات المؤثرين من العميل
pmoRequirements.description: New 'Wrong Coverage' section on the Admin Campaign Coverage page listing influencers whose coverage the client rejected, plus two new filters: Channel Coverage Status (accepted / rejected) and Influencer Coverage Status (fully Rejected / fully Accepted).
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Wrong Coverage section visible to Admin; both coverage-status filters return correct accepted/rejected sets.

pmoRequirements.title: Redirect legacy brand name searches to TryGC
pmoRequirements.titleAr: توجيه نتائج البحث عن الاسم القديم Grand Community
pmoRequirements.description: Redirect searches for the old brand name 'Grand Community' to TryGC's current information, so searchers do not land on dead legacy pages and we do not lose inbound demand.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Search for the old name surfaces TryGC content in the top results; no dead legacy pages rank.

pmoRequirements.title: Auto-refresh Best Media metrics
pmoRequirements.titleAr: تحديث بيانات Best Media أوتوماتيك
pmoRequirements.description: Continuously refresh Best Media views, comments and likes, because these numbers keep climbing after publication — a reel at 50K views on day one reaches 300K a week later and a frozen figure understates both us and the influencer.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Metrics refresh on a defined schedule and reports reflect current values.

pmoRequirements.title: Brand-level page size (50 vs 100)
pmoRequirements.titleAr: عرض 50 مؤثر على الأقل في كل صفحة عند البراند
pmoRequirements.description: Show at least 50 influencers per page at brand level so the brand can compare a meaningful set at once.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Page size at brand level confirmed and applied consistently.
pmoRequirements.clarificationNeeded: Direct conflict with INF-11 (100 per page). The source explicitly asks management to decide which number applies on which screen.

pmoRequirements.title: Auto-update influencer city from last visit
pmoRequirements.titleAr: تحديث مدينة المؤثر المسجّلة بناءً على آخر زيارة
pmoRequirements.description: Update the registered city from the most recent visit city when the influencer has no city on record or the registered city differs from the last visit — stale city data wastes a campaign slot and everyone's time.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: City updated on both trigger conditions; every change written to an audit trail.

pmoRequirements.title: Add SWARM as a supported platform
pmoRequirements.titleAr: إضافة منصة SWARM كمنصة مدعومة
pmoRequirements.description: Support SWARM as a social platform everywhere platforms appear — the create-influencer screen, the influencer card and reports — so work on new platforms can be tracked and reported.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: SWARM selectable on create, visible on the card and included in reporting.

pmoRequirements.title: Category on every brand, including retroactive cleanup
pmoRequirements.titleAr: إضافة فئة Category لكل البراندات اللي اشتغلنا معاها
pmoRequirements.description: Assign a category to every brand we have worked with, applied retroactively across historical data (restaurant = F&B, clothing store = Fashion, clinic = Health). This taxonomy underpins several other requirements.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: 100% of brands categorised, including historical ones, against an agreed category list.

pmoRequirements.title: Multiple countries per influencer
pmoRequirements.titleAr: السماح بأكثر من دولة للمؤثر الواحد (Multi-Select)
pmoRequirements.description: Allow multi-select of countries per influencer so people who genuinely live between two countries (e.g. Egypt and the UAE) appear in both markets' results.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Multi-country saved and honoured by every country filter and campaign query.

pmoRequirements.title: Average Views metric
pmoRequirements.titleAr: إضافة مؤشر متوسط المشاهدات Average Views
pmoRequirements.description: Add Average Views next to Total Followers on the influencer page and in the Wishlist, with per-channel averages on hover, because follower count is a misleading number — 1M followers at 10K views signals a disengaged or purchased audience, while 90K followers at 60K views is a find.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Average Views shown at influencer and per-channel level, matching the reporting definition.

pmoRequirements.title: Remove metrics with no real data source
pmoRequirements.titleAr: إزالة الأرقام التي ليس لها مصدر بيانات حقيقي
pmoRequirements.description: Drop Impressions and Reach from reports because they have no genuine data source, and give Admin a switch to bring them back if they become available later.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Impressions and Reach absent from all client-facing reports; Admin toggle restores them without a release.

pmoRequirements.title: Full-screen Look-Alike window
pmoRequirements.titleAr: تكبير نافذة Look-Alike على الشاشة كلها
pmoRequirements.description: Look-Alike currently shows only 3 rows; add an option to expand it full screen so a large candidate set can be compared at once.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Full-screen mode available, scroll position preserved on exit, results unchanged.

pmoRequirements.title: Chained filtering without reloading all data
pmoRequirements.titleAr: تشغيل الفلتر على نتيجة الفلتر الذي قبله
pmoRequirements.description: Each new filter must apply to the result set produced by the previous filter instead of reloading the full dataset — filter Egypt > Cairo > Zamalek > female, get 40 results, then sort by followers and only those 40 are re-sorted.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Filter state accumulates; sorting and further filters never reset the result set to the full population.

pmoRequirements.title: Filter influencers by campaign with per-person status
pmoRequirements.titleAr: فلتر حسب الحملة في صفحة المؤثرين مع حالة كل مؤثر
pmoRequirements.description: On the influencers page, selecting a campaign lists everyone who took part with their individual status (visited, produced coverage, missed the appointment), so a proven roster can be rebuilt quickly.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Campaign filter returns the participant roster with visited / coverage / missed flags per person.

pmoRequirements.title: Pagination instead of Load More
pmoRequirements.titleAr: تغيير صفحة المؤثرين من Load More لنظام صفحات
pmoRequirements.description: Replace Load More with real pagination at 100 influencers per page with numbered pages, because Load More degrades as the page grows and a refresh loses your position.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Numbered pages, 100 per page, deep-linkable page state, no progressive slowdown.
pmoRequirements.clarificationNeeded: Conflicts with BRD-05, which asks for 50 per page at brand level. Management must decide which number applies on which screen.

pmoRequirements.title: Standalone CONTENT section
pmoRequirements.titleAr: قسم مستقل جديد اسمه CONTENT
pmoRequirements.description: Promote content out of the Top Coverage filter into a standalone CONTENT section on the influencers page, filterable by content type (Reels, Post, Photo, Story) and by audio treatment (Voice-over, Music, Silent).
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: CONTENT section live with type and audio filters; 'reels with voice-over' returns the expected set.

pmoRequirements.title: Alert when re-adding a previously rejected influencer
pmoRequirements.titleAr: تحذير Alert عند إضافة مؤثرين اترفضوا قبل كده للحملة
pmoRequirements.description: Warning alert when an influencer who was rejected before is added to a campaign.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Alert blocks or warns on add, shows the prior rejection reason and date, and can be overridden by an authorised role.
pmoRequirements.clarificationNeeded: Source document leaves this open. Confirm: does 'rejected before' mean client rejection only or internal rejection too, and what lookback window applies?

pmoRequirements.title: Consolidated report across all client campaigns
pmoRequirements.titleAr: تقرير للعميل يجمع كل حملاته في مكان واحد
pmoRequirements.description: A single consolidated report that aggregates every campaign belonging to one client.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: One report covers all campaigns for a client; per-campaign subtotals reconcile to the consolidated total.

pmoRequirements.title: Per-campaign Achieved breakdown chart
pmoRequirements.titleAr: رسم بياني يقسّم رقم Achieved على كل حملة
pmoRequirements.description: Chart in the consolidated report that splits Achieved per campaign for every metric, so the aggregate cannot hide a weak campaign (e.g. 90 total = 50+40 or 85+5, a very different picture).
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Every consolidated chart (views, likes, channels) is segmented by campaign; values reconcile to the total.

pmoRequirements.title: Export reports to Excel and PowerPoint
pmoRequirements.titleAr: تصدير التقرير على شكل إكسل وباوربوينت
pmoRequirements.description: Add Excel and PowerPoint export alongside the locked PDF, so clients can edit figures and drop them into their own board decks.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Excel and PPT exports contain the same figures as the PDF and open without repair prompts.

pmoRequirements.title: Brand-level breakdown in the company report
pmoRequirements.titleAr: إضافة تفاصيل البراندات في تقرير الشركة
pmoRequirements.description: Break the company report down by brand, because one company can hold several brands and management wants to see what each brand delivered.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Brand subtotals present and reconciling to the company total.

pmoRequirements.title: Export Wishlist with all influencer data
pmoRequirements.titleAr: تصدير الويش ليست مع كل بيانات المؤثرين
pmoRequirements.description: Export Wishlist to Excel including every visible column and any additional fields the brand needs for their own review.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Excel export matches displayed columns and opens without data truncation.

pmoRequirements.title: Internal rejection tracking with reason and team
pmoRequirements.titleAr: تتبع الرفض الداخلي مع السبب والفريق
pmoRequirements.description: Track internal rejections with a reason taxonomy and the team responsible, so patterns can be analysed and coaching directed where needed.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Every internal rejection logged with a reason code and team tag; reports query rejections by team and reason.

pmoRequirements.title: Approved from previous campaigns
pmoRequirements.titleAr: إعادة استخدام المؤثرين المعتمدين سابقاً
pmoRequirements.description: Surface influencers who were approved for previous campaigns with this client, so the approval cycle can be shortened by re-using proven people.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Pre-approved influencers flagged and optionally auto-included; approval history visible to the team.

pmoRequirements.title: Community-created influencer flow
pmoRequirements.titleAr: إضافة مؤثرين من فريق المجتمع
pmoRequirements.description: Allow Community team to create new influencers who then route through the approval workflow before becoming visible to brands.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Community-created influencers visible only after approval; workflow logs the approval decision.

pmoRequirements.title: Gender Target per brand
pmoRequirements.titleAr: إضافة حقل Gender Target لكل براند
pmoRequirements.description: Record the gender target for each brand (male, female, both) so influencer sourcing can be filtered accordingly without asking the brand every time.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Gender Target editable on brand profile and included in sourcing filters.

pmoRequirements.title: Influencer History navigation
pmoRequirements.titleAr: تنظيم صفحة تاريخ المؤثر
pmoRequirements.description: Reorganise the Influencer History section so campaign history is easy to navigate when an influencer has worked with many brands.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: History page navigable when 50+ campaigns exist; filters and grouping by brand or time work correctly.
pmoRequirements.clarificationNeeded: Decide Influencer History navigation model (single ACTIVE vs split).

pmoRequirements.title: Scanner Approved tabs
pmoRequirements.titleAr: تابات الموافقة في السكانر
pmoRequirements.description: Add tabs on the Scanner screen to separate influencers by approval status, so field staff can see who is ready to visit versus who is still pending.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Tabs filter Scanner list by approval status; counts update in real time.
pmoRequirements.clarificationNeeded: Fix the exact list of statuses for the Scanner Approved tabs.

pmoRequirements.title: Bee Cloud reconciliation
pmoRequirements.titleAr: مطابقة Bee Cloud
pmoRequirements.description: Automated reconciliation between coverage files in Bee Cloud and coverage records in the system, with an exception report for mismatches.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Weekly reconciliation runs automatically; exceptions emailed to Operations and Finance.

pmoRequirements.title: Cross-platform messaging block
pmoRequirements.titleAr: منع التواصل عبر المنصة الخاطئة
pmoRequirements.description: Block WhatsApp messages from being sent under the wrong brand or platform identity — the system should warn or prevent when the influencer's platform does not match the campaign.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Mismatched platform messages blocked or warned before send; override available for authorised users.

pmoRequirements.title: Shift summary email
pmoRequirements.titleAr: إيميل ملخص الشيفت
pmoRequirements.description: Automated email at the end of each shift summarising visits, coverage received and outstanding actions.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Email sent at configured time; content matches shift data; recipients configurable by role.

pmoRequirements.title: Unanswered message alert
pmoRequirements.titleAr: تنبيه الرسائل غير المجابة
pmoRequirements.description: Alert when WhatsApp messages remain unanswered beyond a configured threshold, so conversations do not go cold.
pmoRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Alert fires when threshold exceeded; configurable per channel and per team.
pmoRequirements.clarificationNeeded: Define unanswered-message alert thresholds per channel.
